result:
**Verdict: FAIL.** The candidate is the frozen `sha256:cf40705b…` (2,720 files), recomputed on a complete clone at source commit `9bb2207`. Seven of my eight round-1 findings are verified closed. F-DG6-144 (Low) stays open, and the assignment allows PASS only if all eight close. Nothing Critical, High, Medium or mandatory is open in my scope.

**Round-1 findings, re-tested on this candidate:**

| Finding | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| F-DG6-140 (Medium) | Closed | My round-1 probe and 3 new adversarial cases pass (stale data in an earlier period now opens one `data_stale` event, with no false stale). Reverting the fix makes my probe and the candidate's own test fail. |
| F-DG6-141 (Medium) | Closed | Export start and import upload now return 429 at their class budget, including the documented defaults (10 and 30 per minute). Unwiring them is caught by the candidate's `rate-limits.test.ts`. |
| F-DG6-142 (Medium) | Closed | The in-tree generator's dataset is served by the API (30/30 initiatives, 3/3 transformations). The only non-RFC ids (120 of 770,559 checked) are DG5 catalogue rows that an empty migrated database already contains. The old generator fails 4/4 of the id test. |
| F-DG6-143 (Low) | Closed | Upload policy is 360 = 360 px and 1280 = 1280 at 200 % text, in en and ar. A build without the fix reproduces the round-1 overflow exactly (385 > 360). |
| **F-DG6-144 (Low)** | **Open** | `p4-benefits` test 8 is named in the finding's own reproduction and listed as "Not done" in FE-Y1's handback. It hit the default 30 s timeout in 3 of 4 full product runs. `p4-gates-closure` 6 and `p3-journeys` 2a also time out, and again when run alone. With a 120 s budget all 36 tests of those specs pass, so only the budget is missing. 14 specs still budget only some of their tests. |
| F-DG6-145 (Low) | Closed | Both tests pass in both integration runs under load. Comparing the session columns again makes the new test fail. |
| F-DG6-146 (Low) | Closed | Route-inventory case 4 now returns 400 for all 482 operations. Restoring the old parsing is caught. |
| F-DG6-147 (Medium) | Closed | At the idle criterion (load ≤ 1.0), 0 of 132 export starts took over 2 s; with 50 started at once the slowest took 772 ms. Round 1 had 38 of 50 over 2 s. All other clauses held. |

**New findings (both Low, not blocking):**
- **F-DG6-200** (owner: backend-workflow-engineer): two integration tests fail now and then because of how the tests are written, not the product.
  - The new export guard test claims the job while its own refused update is still aborting. My probe misses 5 of 40 times as written, 0 of 40 with a 250 ms pause, and 0 of 40 without the refused update.
  - `change-requests-in-tx` reads two audit rows without ordering them. The product behaviour is correct in 15 of 15 checks.
- **F-DG6-201** (owner: transformation-analyst): the register notes for REQ-S12-019, REQ-S16-030, REQ-S20-029 and REQ-S20-030 still describe the round-1 gaps the repairs closed. This is documentation drift only.

**Everything else ran.** Every failure in my logs is explained in the record:
- **Static checks:** all exit 0, including the contrast check and the 932 API operations.
- **Unit tests:** run on Node 24 and Node 22, with the locale unset and with C.UTF-8. The only failures were load timeouts, and all six affected files pass when run alone. The Node 22 available is 22.22.0, not the 22.22.2 the assignment names.
- **Integration:** run twice. Run 2 is 413/413 files and 4,190 tests. Run 1's failures were load timeouts, one test-process crash under memory pressure (the remaining files ran as a continuation), and the two F-DG6-200 tests.
- **`tests/qa` on its own:** 45 integration and 6 unit files pass.
- **Root acceptance and demo e2e:** green after re-running browser crashes caused by memory pressure. The C.UTF-8 run passed 288 tests, and every connection logged during it went to the local machine only (REQ-S17-009).
- **Product journeys:** the only failures are the 30 s timeouts above.
- **My own probes:** the auditor role sees no enabled write controls, layouts reflow at 360 px, 390 px and 200 % text, API validation errors appear in the selected language, and clearing browser storage loses no data.
- **Gate validators:** the register, pipeline and historical DG1–DG5 checks all pass.
- **Load on a quiet host (provisional):** reads p95 20.7 ms, dashboards 39.8 ms.

Two runs used my own scripts wrongly the first time; both are disclosed in the logs. The freshness probe compared "0.90" against the stored "0.9", and the rate-limit probe first measured the test harness's raised budget instead of the product default. My first load run on the saturated host is kept and labelled as a measurement of host saturation, not of the product.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG6/round-2/qa-verifier.json`
- `reviews/DG6/round-2/qa-verifier.verifications.json`
- `reviews/DG6/round-2/qa-verifier.findings.json`
- `reviews/DG6/round-2/qa-verifier.md`
- evidence in `test-evidence/DG6/qa/round-2/`
- my tests in `test-evidence/DG6/qa/tests/round-2/`
